title: Google\Cloud\Firestore\FieldValue
name: FieldValue
description: Provides special field values for Cloud Firestore.

methods.name: deleteField
methods.description: Denotes a field which should be deleted from a Firestore Document.

methods.name: serverTimestamp
methods.description: Denotes a field which should be set to the server timestamp.

methods.name: arrayUnion
methods.description: Returns a special value that can be used with set(), create() or update() that tells the server to union the given elements with any array value that already exists on the server. Each specified element that doesn't already exist in the array will be added to the end. If the field being modified is not already an array it will be overwritten with an array containing exactly the specified elements.

params.name: elements
params.description: The elements to union into the array.

methods.name: arrayRemove
methods.description: Returns a special value that can be used with set(), create() or update() that tells the server to remove the given elements from any array value that already exists on the server. All instances of each element specified will be removed from the array. If the field being modified is not already an array it will be overwritten with an empty array.

params.name: elements
params.description: The elements to remove from the array.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Returns a special value that can be used with set() or update() that tells the server to add the given value to the field's current value.
